items.t: Investors Heavily Search Ford Motor Company (F): Here is What You Need to Know
items.sum: Zacks.com users have recently been watching Ford Motor (F) quite a bit. Thus, it is worth knowing the facts that could determine the stock's prospects.

items.t: This Ford sculptor has carved cars out of clay for 40 years. AI and VR just cut his work time in half
items.sum: Ford’s latest rebirth includes factories filled with 3D-printed parts and clay-carving artisans wearing virtual-reality goggles.

items.t: The Zacks Analyst Blog Highlights Tesla, SpaceX and Ford
items.sum: TSLA is winding down Cybertruck production by 2027 to make way for Cybercab, betting on autonomous rides and robotics despite unproven commercial returns.

items.t: A $776 Car Payment Is a Warning for Ford and General Motors
items.sum: As the U.S. drives towards higher new car prices, it faces an affordability crisis leaving some consumers out of the market. This could be a problem for Ford and GM.

items.t: Ford’s Jim Farley Isn’t the Only One Worried About BYD, Geely and Chinese Automakers: UAW Sends Warning to Congress, Says ‘China Must Not Gain a Foothold’
items.sum: UAW urges Congress to shield U.S. automakers from Chinese EV competition, echoing Ford CEO Jim Farley’s warnings about foreign market gains.
